title: split — 'it depends 40% on X, 30% on Y, 30% on Z': the parts land one by one on their words, then each dives into one ring and fills its share of the whole on its number while the total counts to 100

icon.description: an icon from _icons.html (bulb, hook, gem, doc, film, …)

label.description: the speaker's word for the part

color.description: optional override; default gold, azure, white, light azure

items.description: the parts in spoken order; shares should total 100

total_label.description: the speaker's word for the whole

source.description: where the shares come from — required by validate-plan

reveal_at.description: [land_0 … land_n-1, gather (the ring rises), fill_0 … fill_n-1 (on each number)]
